description: Department of Local Government Central Province - Drinking water and water catchment safety by - Law of the Ambagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha.
categorisation: This gazette content establishes a new by-law (Drinking Water and Water Catchment Safety By-law) for the Ambagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha, outlining regulatory requirements, compliance standards, and enforcement mechanisms for water safety. It falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it creates new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than dealing with government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
